posts.cooked: I dont know how to access the vm when i went and submitted my public ssh key it is showing errors like the key should start with ssh- or it atleast should have 2 parts and all . Am i entering the wrong key there ?

posts.name: sandeepkumar sudhakar surkute
posts.cooked:
Instruction given on below two linked will be helpful. Don’t generate new ssh key, the public key which you already generated for course VM can be used for OPPE VM also. NPPE and OPPE VM are same.

if after uploading public key login using the ssh command given in the link. if there are issues still then follow other posts where ssh-keygen -R “OPPE hostname” related solution is also given.
